#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

    try {
        std::string line;
        std::getline(std::cin, line);
        int len = std::stoi(line);
        std::string s;
        std::getline(std::cin, s);

        int maxOutside = 0;
        int outsideWord = 0;
        int insideWord = 0;
        int verbCount = 0;
        bool inside = false;

        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == '(') {
                maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, outsideWord);
                outsideWord = 0;
                inside = true;
                insideWord = 0;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                inside = false;
                if (insideWord != 0) {
                    verbCount++;
                }
                insideWord = 0;
            } else if (!inside) {
                if (c == '_') {
                    maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, outsideWord);
                    outsideWord = 0;
                } else {
                    outsideWord++;
                }
            } else {
                if (c == '_') {
                    if (insideWord != 0) {
                        verbCount++;
                    }
                    insideWord = 0;
                } else {
                    insideWord++;
                }
            }
        }

        maxOutside = std::max(maxOutside, outsideWord);

        std::cout << maxOutside << " ";
        std::cout << verbCount;
    } catch (std::exception& e) {
        std::cout << 0 << " 0" << 0;
    }
    return 0;
}
